intro.title: CSS architecture
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple, responsive webpage to learn the fundamentals of CSS architecture. You will apply core concepts like separation of concerns, maintainability, and scalability by organizing your styles effectively. The main technologies involved are HTML for structure and CSS for styling, using techniques such as semantic class naming and modular CSS. By the end, you'll understand how to structure CSS to keep your code clean and easy to manage as projects grow.
intro.usecase: CSS architecture is essential for maintaining large-scale applications like e-commerce platforms, where consistent styling must be applied across thousands of product cards, navigation menus, and checkout forms. In enterprise dashboards, a well-structured CSS system ensures that data tables, charts, and control panels remain visually cohesive as new features are added. Developers rely on CSS architecture patterns like BEM or utility-first approaches to efficiently manage design systems in complex applications like social media feeds or admin interfaces, where reusable components prevent styling conflicts and speed up development.
